We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 85,000+ companies use to move money. About the Role Most agent work today is one agent, one trace, and a person reads the result. We're building systems where that stops working: thousands of agents fanned out over a large search space, each returning partial results, with an orchestrator that turns all of it into something useful: hundreds of merged PRs, a dataset, the input to another system, or something nobody has built yet. description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. About the role Connectors let Replit’s agents and applications securely access the tools and data people already use. Behind every connection are hard systems problems: whose identity is being used, what they’re allowed to access, how credentials stay valid, and how those guarantees hold across services and execution environments. We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Software Engineer with deep experience in authentication, authorization, security, and distributed systems to own this foundation. You’ll build and operate the infrastructure that makes connections work reliably across Replit’s projects, agent conversations, and environment builds. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a security advisory position or a job focused on adding individual integrations. You’ll trace behavior across service boundaries, make architectural decisions, ship production changes, and simplify an evolving platform. Success means connections are secure and reliable end to end, and the team can confidently build on the systems you own. You will Own authentication and authorization across the connection lifecycle. Design how users, agents, applications, and services establish identity, receive access, and act on behalf of others. Build reliable credential infrastructure. Handle OAuth flows, token refresh, revocation, reauthorization, and secure credential storage, including concurrency and partial failures. Make connections work across the platform. title: Software Engineer, Agent Identity
description: About the Team The Agent Identity team builds the foundational identity infrastructure that enables AI agents to securely act on behalf of users and organizations. We develop the systems that allow agents to establish their identity, demonstrate whose authority they are operating under, and securely access resources across applications and environments. Our team owns agent identity and delegation, authentication and authorization, credential lifecycle management, revocation, and integrations with external platforms. We also build Sign in with ChatGPT, enabling OpenAI to serve as an identity provider across a growing ecosystem of applications. As AI agents become increasingly autonomous, our work is foundational to how users, organizations, and developers establish trust in agentic systems. About the Role We are looking for experienced software engineers to design and build the identity infrastructure powering the next generation of AI agents across OpenAI’s products, including ChatGPT and Codex. You will tackle complex, largely unsolved engineering challenges at the intersection of identity, security, distributed systems, and agent infrastructure. You’ll help define how agents authenticate across environments, how users securely delegate authority to agents, and how agents interact with external applications and services. This is an opportunity to shape foundational technical primitives at OpenAI while helping influence how the broader industry approaches identity in an increasingly agent-driven world. In this role, you will: Design and build foundational agent identity primitives, including agent authentication, delegated authorization, and credential lifecycle management.
